feature_contract.goal: Ensure original ESC/pause shell and twelve exact option-arrow E8 sources alone receive the independent R84 binocular pause optical size and vertical positioning, while unrelated native screen HUD clips and callbacks that leave VR/pause cannot borrow the paused stereo plane.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only exact native ESC E8 arrow producer and queue registration plus R84 paused ScreenHud renderer admission; leave PauseFrameShell, unrelated generic HUD, +TIME/GOAL, F11, title/selector, normal race world, R26_SAFE rollback, input/FFB, SkyGlow, DX11 and frozen DXVK unchanged.
trace_stages: Original ESC option-arrow calls at RVA E358B/E35A3/E35CC/E35F7/E481B/E4833/E485C/E4887/EC24C/EC277/ED4D4/ED7A3 are redirected to PauseOptionArrow_putClipSprite, not shared generic clip producers.

PauseOptionArrow native producer enters exact ScreenHud source scope, snapshots VR and pause mode, and calls the original put_clip_sprite; a native callback may reenter before returning with SpriteNode siblings.

Original queued sprites retain the exact PauseOptionArrow node owner only across a stable native VR and pause transition; reverted or foreign queue routes retain original native Draw/fallback without pause-owned stereo affinity.

R84 R30 classifies the physical game ScreenHud Draw from the exact PauseOptionArrow token before applying left/right ESC-specific contain and signed vertical pixel shift; generic ExactScreenHudClipSprite cannot inherit that plane while paused.
subcomponents: Correct R84 physical pause admission so the exact original ESC arrow E8 token, not unrelated generic exact ScreenHud clip token, owns pause optical scale and Y offset.
Fence original native queued ESC sprite registration across both entry and exit VR/pause state while retaining the original game's sprite submission and safely tagged legitimate siblings.
Add compile-time and executable positive and negative pause state-transition/VR toggle ownership regressions without changing shell/gameplay/HUD fallback.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Only the original exact ESC option arrows receive R84 left/right pause containment and vertical positioning; real paused shell retains its own producer and ordinary generic HUD clips cannot impersonate ESC arrows.

A nested VR exit, pause exit or false-to-true mode transition cannot tag a foreign queued native child as an ESC arrow; unchanged pause contexts retain sibling provenance and the original native result/Draw.

Final validation-bearing exact SHA passes DX9Ex Active x86 game/x64 host/package, Domain Isolation, HUD Inspector and Full Source Impact; Quest3/VDXR optical and FFB acceptance remain separately UNTESTED.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Source inspection of hooks_uiscaling.cpp confirms twelve separate original ESC option-arrow E8 call replacements already mark PauseOptionArrow, whereas generic ExactScreenHud clip sources also exist and are shared with non-ESC callers; R30 previously accepted either token during paused mode.
diagnosis.root_cause: R30IsPauseMenuExactArrow accepted unrelated generic ExactScreenHudClipSprite whenever the original game paused, giving unowned text/clip HUD the ESC-exclusive eye plane. The exact native arrow queued helper also registered children after reentrant VR/menu transitions without checking that producer-entry identity still held.
source_trace: Original ESC arrow E8 -> PauseOptionArrow_putClipSprite -> exact native ScreenHud producer -> Game::put_clip_sprite and stable-root SpriteNode tail tagging.
Each selected queue node receives its producer token and scope through render_semantics while R84 R30 resolves the current physical ScreenHud GPU Draw classification.
An exact PauseOptionArrow may enter per-eye ESC containment/vertical translation; unknown or stale native sprites retain conservative R84 or original draw fallback without widening GOAL/F11/world.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: R84 stereo admission now requires the proven exact PauseOptionArrow source and safe mode-preserved queued registration; the shell remains exact PauseFrameShell. This prevents a foreign HUD Draw borrowing the pause-only left/right eye transform, but headset optics are not established without Quest3 verification.
alternatives_rejected: Do not infer ESC ownership from state 0x12 alone or from any generic ExactScreenHudClipSprite, and do not move F11 or HUD/GOAL into a pause plane.
Do not suppress native sprite Draw or skip returned HRESULT, flush unrelated D3DX batches, or alter R26_SAFE fallback.
